Personal Info

Hello, I'm Seth Daniel M. Fernandez.

A Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student, Web Track, at the University of the Cordilleras. I want to help others and share my knowledge in web development and creative design. As a web developer, my goal is to create websites that are built to last.
